label: fs-w148-fp8-output-rank-phase-r1
purpose: Same-source/host full-model direct BxTxC FP8 output after resident control and all independent/real-Linear gates. Thirty timed updates plus five warmups; all cache/communication/optimizer costs included. Compare against same-source resident compact control. A new same-host native control is required before any speed-based quality promotion; no BPB claim.
